questions:
1. What is your house type? (detached, semi-detached, or apartment) [mandatory]
2. What year was your house built?
3. What is the approximate heated floor area in square meters?

messages.content: Hallo und herzlich willkommen! Ich bin Ihr Assistent für Wärmepumpen-Empfehlungen. Um Ihnen optimal helfen zu können, möchte ich eine Heizungsbewertung durchführen, indem ich Ihnen einige Fragen stelle. Und hier ist die erste Frage: Was ist Ihr Haustyp? (freistehend, Doppelhaushälfte oder Wohnung?)

Natürlich! I'll continue in English from now on. I'm here to assist you with a heat pump recommendation. To get started, could you please tell me what type of house you have? Is it a detached house, semi-detached house, or an apartment?
Thank you for letting me know that your house is detached. Next, could you please tell me in what year your house was built?
Thank you! Your house was built in 1995. Now, could you please tell me the approximate heated floor area of your house in square meters?
Could you please confirm if this information is correct, or would you like to change anything?

Thank you for the update! The heated floor area is 100 square meters. 

I have gathered all the necessary information. Thank you!
